notes: Profiles: Manage profiles is easier to reach and to focus with the remote, Add profile / Add Kids are now tucked inside Manage profiles instead of cluttering the main picker, and you can delete a profile from its edit screen. Video player: paused screens are cleaner — the floating info card is gone, the top bar is slimmer with just a back button, title, and a favourite star, and the bottom controls get a tinted progress bar and glass-styled background.
